title: CABAL: Revolution — Combo InterActive’s newest mobile MMORPG announces simultaneous CBT on November 5

blocks.text: Combo InterActive, the online game publisher behind CABAL: Infinite Combo and CABAL: Ultimate Combo, hosted CABAL: Revolution Night to unveil its new title, CABAL: Revolution. The MMORPG features a rebalanced experience designed to be more fun, more accessible, and fairer for every player. The Closed Beta Test (CBT) will launch simultaneously across Southeast Asia from November 5–17, 2026.

blocks.caption: CABAL: Revolution — Combo InterActive’s newest mobile MMORPG announces simultaneous CBT on November 5

blocks.text: A Complete Rebalance Across All 9 Classes

blocks.caption: CABAL: Revolution — Combo InterActive’s newest mobile MMORPG announces simultaneous CBT on November 5

blocks.text: CABAL: Revolution delivers a full-scale rebalance of all 9 classes, making the game more enjoyable than ever before. Highlights include:

items: Warrior — The Sub Skill “Bloody Spirit,” which previously reduced Max Defense by 25% at Level 20, has been buffed to 69%, making the Warrior class significantly more durable.

Wizard — The attack range of Battle Mode 3 has been extended from 7 cells to 8 cells. In addition, the Sub Skill “Spirit Shield” has been buffed from 4,000 to 40,000 Damage Absorption at Level 20, greatly improving the Wizard’s survivability.

blocks.text: The remaining 7 classes have also been adjusted so that every player can enjoy the game even more. The rebalance reflects a deep understanding of each class and fully addresses the game’s previous weak points. Furthermore, every item on this server can be obtained in-game.

items: Many more Quality of Life (QoL) improvements!

blocks.text: Interested players can join the test during the CBT period from November 5–17, 2026.

During the official launch, players who wish to play CABAL: Revolution must purchase an Entry Package to access the game. Each sales phase offers a different price and number of accounts — the earlier you buy, the better the value compared to purchasing closer to the official launch.
Players who purchase the Entry Package will also receive the following in-game items to support their gameplay during the official launch:

Inexhaustible HP Potion (Lv.4) (7 Days): 1 EAInexhaustible MP Potion (Lv.4) (7 Days): 1 EAHoly Water of Fighter (15 min) ×20 (Permanent): 1 EAHoly Water of Sage (15 min) ×20 (Permanent): 1 EAHoly Water of Critical Strike (15 min) ×20 (Permanent): 1 EAGM’s Blessing (Lv.2) Holy Water ×10 (Permanent): 1 EAUniversal Attack UP (Lv.1) ×50 (Permanent): 1 EAUniversal Defense UP (Lv.1) ×50 (Permanent): 1 EAUniversal Buff Time UP (Lv.1) ×50 (Permanent): 1 EABlessing Bead – EXP (1,000%) (7 Days): 1 EABlessing Bead – Skill EXP (1,000%) (7 Days): 1 EABlessing Bead – Pet EXP (1,000%) (7 Days): 1 EAForcegem Package 40,000 (Permanent): 1 EA
Monthly Packages are also available for players looking to take their convenience to the next level, offered in 4 tiers:

items: $3 Package: Receive 1,500 Force Gem instantly, plus 50 Force Gem and Dungeon Token 1 ×30 throughout 30 days.
$10 Package: Receive 5,000 Force Gem instantly, plus 200 Force Gem and Gemstone of Transcendence ×30 throughout 30 days.

$30 Package: Receive 15,000 Force Gem, Jewel Cube – Sapphire (Silver) (7 Days), and Jewel Cube – Ruby (Silver) (7 Days) instantly, plus 700 Force Gem and GM’s Blessing (Lv.2) Holy Water ×5 (7 Days) throughout 30 days.
$100 Package: Receive 50,000 Force Gem, Blessing Bead – Platinum Wing (30 Days), and Blessing Bead – Silver Wing (30 Days) instantly, plus 2,400 Force Gem and Merit Medal ×10 throughout 30 days.
